title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4CITY - Facility
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/Facility. A place, amenity, or piece of equipment provided for a particular purpose (definition taken from https://en.oxforddictionaries.com/definition/facility). Used in SAREF4CITY as the place where an Event takes place (s4city:takesPlaceAtFacility) or a PublicService is involved (s4city:involvesFacility). Subclass of geo:Feature (http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Feature), from which it inherits the topology pattern used throughout SAREF4CITY: a geospatial position (mapped here to the standard NGSI-LD `location` GeoProperty, derived from geo:hasGeometry) and the geo:sfContains / geo:sfWithin containment relationships.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Facility'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

location.description: GeoProperty. GeoJSON reference to the item, derived from geo:hasGeometry. Point providing the geographical position of the facility.

coordinates.description: Property. Coordinates of the Point, in WGS84 [longitude, latitude] order.

sfContains.description: Relationship. Model:'http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#sfContains'. Other geo:Feature entities spatially contained within this facility.

sfWithin.description: Relationship. Model:'http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#sfWithin'. The geo:Feature (e.g. an AdministrativeArea) that this facility is spatially within.
